title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for Dating Apps in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to a dating app: profiles and photos, matching, real-time chat, the safety tools Apple requires, verification, and subscriptions.
body_markdown: It is not required, but builder guides from Catdoes and Superappp describe photo or ID verification as a signal that builds trust and speeds approval. Blink apps can screen photos with image models inside the app.
